The smallest charger in my bag is also the one I use the most.

I never thought I'd get excited about a charger...

...until I came across the Nu Republic Cybotron Cube 45W during the bigbasket Electronics Mela Sale .

It's compact enough to slip into any pocket, yet powerful enough to become my everyday charger.

⚡ 45W GaN Fast Charging
🔌 1 USB-C + 1 USB-A port
💻 Charge your phone, earbuds, tablet or even compatible laptops—with one compact charger.

》What I love most about GaN chargers is that they pack serious power into a much smaller body while staying cooler and more efficient than traditional chargers.

📌 And here's the cherry on top...

My order even came with a FREE Type-C charging cable . 🙌

With the huge discount on BigBasket and the free cable, it didn't feel like I was just buying a charger.

It felt like I was upgrading my everyday carry.

● If you're browsing the bigbasket Electronics Mela Sale, don't overlook the essentials.

Sometimes the products you use every single day end up being the best purchases you make. ⚡
